info.title: Munim core-api — /internal/intel/v1
info.description: Generated by packages/contracts/scripts/gen.ts from the zod sources — do not edit; run `make contracts`. All data is synthetic; suppliers are simulated; payments are recorded, never processed.

post.summary: Durable event dedupe; a repeat claim is 409
Leading-edge debounce for a pack's watcher
Run an allow-listed template under the run's tenant and outlet scope
Draft proposal; numeric payload fields must be refs
Validated answer envelope (or a stored abstention)
Append trace events (at most 500 per call)
Text chunks of documents and messages (idempotent by id)
Extracted claims; each quote must be its source span (MB012 refuses the batch)
Graph edges with provenance (idempotent by id)
Wiki page versions of validated cited segments
A forecast run and its points (T-052 output)
One bounded graph template under the run's tenant (ids, kinds, names, depth)
Model spend per call; always recorded, stamped by core

get.summary: The run's pack, thresholds, outlets with business dates, AI budget and narration mode
The ranked inbox for a brief run: stored finding texts, impact refs, draft ids (no dedupe key)

memberToken.description: IdP ID token of a signed-in person (a tenant member; alone on identity routes)

operatorToken.description: IdP ID token of a platform operator

serviceCredential.name: x-munim-service-secret
serviceCredential.description: Service-to-service credential of the intel service

tenantHeader.name: X-Munim-Tenant
tenantHeader.description: The tenant a member acts in (with memberToken)

storefrontKey.name: X-Munim-Storefront-Key
storefrontKey.description: Public storefront key; resolves the tenant and channel

customerToken.description: IdP ID token of a customer (optional on storefront routes)

guestToken.name: X-Munim-Guest-Token
guestToken.description: Guest access token of one order (returned once when the guest places it); with storefrontKey, on routes that mark guest access
